method: Largest main-vehicle silhouette component measured from persisted near-front / near-rear studio images. Vertical position is normalized from detected vehicle bottom=0 to top=1; width is normalized by each view's detected maximum body width. These profiles screen gross front/rear mass distribution only; perspective and studio-image bias remain.

front.source: Elferspot 2025 Porsche 992.2 Carrera front studio image

rear.source: Eurocar Porsche 911 Carrera 992 II rear studio image

transfer_scope.allowed: gross projected width distribution by normalized height; cabin/body taper; shoulder-to-roof relation
transfer_scope.forbidden: manufacturer section dimensions; local surface curvature; exact bumper/aero/trim package; Class-A claims
